verdict.rationale: Auto-remediating agent-readiness criteria is a fair axis for a coding-agent platform like OpenHands, but the evidence pack never mentions agent-readiness assessments, criteria, or scoring. The closest items are generic automations, such as fixing failed CI workflows (openhands-docs-9) and remediating security alerts (openhands-docs-10). Neither is about evaluating or fixing agent-readiness criteria, so they are not credited here.
